# 1.1: Data Preparation
```{r}
library(readxl)

data_file <- file.path(
  "concrete+compressive+strength",
  "Concrete_Data.xls"
)
data <- as.data.frame(read_excel(data_file))

colnames(data) <- c("Cement", "Slag", "FlyAsh", "Water",
                    "Superplasticizer", "CoarseAggregate",
                    "FineAggregate", "Age", "Strength")

test_data <- data[501:630, ]
train_data <- data[-(501:630), ]

cat("Training samples:", nrow(train_data), "\n")
cat("Testing samples:", nrow(test_data), "\n")

x_train <- as.matrix(train_data[, 1:8])
x_test <- as.matrix(test_data[, 1:8])

y_train <- train_data$Strength
y_test <- test_data$Strength

output_dir <- "projects_results"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE,
           recursive = TRUE)


```


# 1.2: Gradient Descent Implementation
```{r}
gradient_descent <- function(x, y, lr = 0.01,
                             max_iter = 10000) {
  x <- cbind(Intercept = 1, as.matrix(x))

  n <- nrow(x)
  beta <- rep(0, ncol(x))
  losses <- numeric(max_iter)

  for (i in 1:max_iter) {

    y_pred <- as.vector(x %*% beta)

    error <- y_pred - y
    losses[i] <- mean(error^2)

    gradient <- (2 / n) * as.vector(t(x) %*% error)

    beta <- beta - lr * gradient

    if (any(!is.finite(beta))) {
      losses <- losses[1:i]
      break
    }
  }

  if (all(is.finite(beta))) {
    final_pred <- as.vector(x %*% beta)
    losses <- c(losses, mean((y - final_pred)^2))
  }

  return(list(beta = beta, loss = losses))
}

evaluate_model <- function(x, y, beta) {

  x <- cbind(1, x)
  pred <- as.vector(x %*% beta)

  mse <- mean((y - pred)^2)
  r2 <- 1 - mse / mean((y - mean(y))^2)

  return(c(MSE = mse, R2 = r2))
}


evaluate_lm <- function(model, data) {

  pred <- predict(model, newdata = data)
  y <- data$Strength

  mse <- mean((y - pred)^2)
  r2 <- 1 - mse / mean((y - mean(y))^2)

  return(c(MSE = mse, R2 = r2))
}

```



# 1.3: Scaling & Convergence Speed
```{r}
model_raw <- gradient_descent(
  x_train,
  y_train,
  lr = 0.00000001,
  max_iter = 100000
)

raw_result <- evaluate_model(
  x_train, y_train, model_raw$beta
)

cat("\nRaw Feature Results:\n")
print(raw_result)

train_mean <- colMeans(x_train)
train_sd <- apply(x_train, 2, sd)

x_train_scaled <- scale(
  x_train,
  center = train_mean,
  scale = train_sd
)

x_test_scaled <- scale(
  x_test,
  center = train_mean,
  scale = train_sd
)

model_scaled <- gradient_descent(
  x_train_scaled,
  y_train,
  lr = 0.01,
  max_iter = 10000
)

scaled_result <- evaluate_model(
  x_train_scaled, y_train, model_scaled$beta
)

cat("\nScaled Feature Results:\n")
print(scaled_result)

plot(
  seq_along(model_raw$loss),
  model_raw$loss,
  type = "l",
  col = "red",
  lwd = 2,
  log = "x",
  xlab = "Iteration (log scale)",
  ylab = "Mean Squared Error",
  main = "Gradient Descent Convergence"
)

lines(
  seq_along(model_scaled$loss),
  model_scaled$loss,
  col = "blue",
  lwd = 2
)

legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("Raw Features", "Standardized Features"),
  col = c("red", "blue"),
  lwd = 2
)

png(file.path(output_dir, "Figure1_Scaling.png"),
    width = 900, height = 650)

plot(seq_along(model_raw$loss), model_raw$loss,
     type = "l", col = "red", lwd = 2,
     log = "x", xlab = "Iteration (log scale)",
     ylab = "MSE", main = "Scaling and Convergence")

lines(seq_along(model_scaled$loss),
      model_scaled$loss, col = "blue", lwd = 2)

legend("topright",
       legend = c("Raw", "Standardized"),
       col = c("red", "blue"), lwd = 2)

dev.off()


#  Q3 training settings and final scores.
export_gd_summary <- function(model, label, lr, max_iter, y) {
  variance_y <- mean((y - mean(y))^2)
  finite_beta <- all(is.finite(model$beta))
  finite_run <- finite_beta && all(is.finite(model$loss))
  positive <- which(is.finite(model$loss) & model$loss < variance_y)
  final_mse <- if (finite_run) tail(model$loss, 1) else NA_real_
  data.frame(
    Model = label, Learning_Rate = lr, Max_Iterations = max_iter,
    Updates = if (finite_beta) length(model$loss) - 1L else length(model$loss),
    Status = if (finite_run) "finite" else "non-finite",
    Final_Train_MSE = final_mse,
    Final_Train_R2 = 1 - final_mse / variance_y,
    First_Positive_R2_Iteration =
      if (length(positive)) positive[1] - 1L else NA_integer_
  )
}
q3_gd_results <- rbind(
  export_gd_summary(model_raw, "Raw", 1e-8, 100000, y_train),
  export_gd_summary(model_scaled, "Standardized", 0.01, 10000, y_train)
)
write.csv(q3_gd_results, file.path(output_dir, "Q3_GD_Results.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Loss histories; record 1 corresponds to zero updates.
export_loss_table <- function(model, label) {
  data.frame(Model = label, Updates = seq_along(model$loss) - 1L,
             Train_MSE = model$loss)
}
write.csv(rbind(export_loss_table(model_raw, "Raw"),
                export_loss_table(model_scaled, "Standardized")),
          file.path(output_dir, "Q3_Loss_History.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# training-only scaling parameters.
write.csv(data.frame(Feature = names(train_mean),
                     Training_Mean = unname(train_mean),
                     Training_SD = unname(train_sd)),
          file.path(output_dir, "Training_Scaling_Parameters.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

```


# 1.4: Scaling & The Optimal Solution
```{r}
lm_raw <- lm(Strength ~ ., data = train_data)

train_scaled <- as.data.frame(x_train_scaled)
train_scaled$Strength <- y_train

lm_scaled <- lm(Strength ~ ., data = train_scaled)

raw_mse <- mean(residuals(lm_raw)^2)
scaled_mse <- mean(residuals(lm_scaled)^2)

raw_r2 <- summary(lm_raw)$r.squared
scaled_r2 <- summary(lm_scaled)$r.squared

print(data.frame(
  Model = c("Raw", "Standardized"),
  MSE = c(raw_mse, scaled_mse),
  R2 = c(raw_r2, scaled_r2)
))

max(abs(fitted(lm_raw) - fitted(lm_scaled)))


# Optimal-model scores and fitted-value agreement.
write.csv(data.frame(Model = c("Raw", "Standardized"),
                     Train_MSE = c(raw_mse, scaled_mse),
                     Train_R2 = c(raw_r2, scaled_r2)),
          file.path(output_dir, "Q4_Scaling_Optimal_Results.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(data.frame(Max_Absolute_Fitted_Difference =
                       max(abs(fitted(lm_raw) - fitted(lm_scaled)))),
          file.path(output_dir, "Q4_Fitted_Difference.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

```


# 1.5: Non-Linear Transformations
```{r}
lm_raw <- lm(Strength ~ ., data = train_data)

train_scaled <- as.data.frame(x_train_scaled)
test_scaled <- as.data.frame(x_test_scaled)

train_scaled$Strength <- y_train
test_scaled$Strength <- y_test

lm_scaled <- lm(Strength ~ ., data = train_scaled)

x_train_log <- log1p(x_train)
x_test_log <- log1p(x_test)

model_log <- gradient_descent(
  x_train_log,
  y_train,
  lr = 0.00001,
  max_iter = 50000
)

train_log <- as.data.frame(x_train_log)
test_log <- as.data.frame(x_test_log)

train_log$Strength <- y_train
test_log$Strength <- y_test

lm_log <- lm(Strength ~ ., data = train_log)

get_scores <- function(model, dataset) {
  actual <- dataset$Strength
  predicted <- predict(model, newdata = dataset)

  mse <- mean((actual - predicted)^2)
  r2 <- 1 - mse / mean((actual - mean(actual))^2)

  return(c(MSE = mse, R2 = r2))
}

raw_train <- get_scores(lm_raw, train_data)
scaled_train <- get_scores(lm_scaled, train_scaled)
log_train <- get_scores(lm_log, train_log)

raw_test <- get_scores(lm_raw, test_data)
scaled_test <- get_scores(lm_scaled, test_scaled)
log_test <- get_scores(lm_log, test_log)

q_results <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Raw", "Standardized", "Log"),
  Train_MSE = c(raw_train["MSE"],
                scaled_train["MSE"],
                log_train["MSE"]),
  Test_MSE = c(raw_test["MSE"],
               scaled_test["MSE"],
               log_test["MSE"]),
  Train_R2 = c(raw_train["R2"],
               scaled_train["R2"],
               log_train["R2"]),
  Test_R2 = c(raw_test["R2"],
              scaled_test["R2"],
              log_test["R2"])
)

print(q_results)

plot(model_raw$loss, type = "l", col = "red",
     log = "x", xlab = "Iterations", ylab = "MSE",
     main = "Gradient Descent Convergence")

lines(model_scaled$loss, col = "blue")
lines(model_log$loss, col = "green")

legend("topright",
       legend = c("Raw", "Standardized", "Log"),
       col = c("red", "blue", "green"), lty = 1)


# All three optimal models' training and testing scores.
write.csv(q_results, file.path(output_dir, "Q5_Model_Performance.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Multivariate GD diagnostics and complete loss histories.
q5_gd_results <- rbind(
  q3_gd_results,
  export_gd_summary(model_log, "Log", 1e-5, 50000, y_train)
)
write.csv(q5_gd_results, file.path(output_dir, "Q3_Q5_GD_Results.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(rbind(export_loss_table(model_raw, "Raw"),
                export_loss_table(model_scaled, "Standardized"),
                export_loss_table(model_log, "Log")),
          file.path(output_dir, "Q3_Q5_Loss_History.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Coefficient estimates and inference for the optimal models.
export_coefficient_table <- function(model, label) {
  s <- summary(model)$coefficients
  data.frame(Model = label, Term = rownames(s),
             Estimate = s[, 1], Standard_Error = s[, 2],
             T_Statistic = s[, 3], P_Value = s[, 4], row.names = NULL)
}
write.csv(rbind(export_coefficient_table(lm_raw, "Raw"),
                export_coefficient_table(lm_scaled, "Standardized"),
                export_coefficient_table(lm_log, "Log")),
          file.path(output_dir, "Optimal_Model_Coefficients.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Save the three-model loss plot; the x-axis uses loss record indices.
png(file.path(output_dir, "Figure2_Transformations.png"),
    width = 1800, height = 1200, res = 200)
plot(model_raw$loss, type = "l", col = "red", lwd = 2,
     log = "x", xlab = "Loss record index (log scale)",
     ylab = "Training MSE", main = "Gradient Descent Convergence")
lines(model_scaled$loss, col = "blue", lwd = 2)
lines(model_log$loss, col = "darkgreen", lwd = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("Raw", "Standardized", "Log"),
       col = c("red", "blue", "darkgreen"), lty = 1, lwd = 2)
dev.off()

```


# 1.6: Univariate vs. Multivariate Coefficients
```{r}
# Original features: retain the baseline rate except for the Age trial.
q6_lr <- 1e-6
q6_age_lr <- 1e-5 # initial setting : 1e-6
q6_max_iter <- 1000000
feature_names <- colnames(x_train)
uni_results <- data.frame()
q6_losses <- setNames(vector("list", length(feature_names)), feature_names)

for (j in seq_along(feature_names)) {
  feature <- feature_names[j]
  x <- matrix(x_train[, j], ncol = 1)

  model_lr <- if (feature == "Age") q6_age_lr else q6_lr
  gd <- gradient_descent(x, y_train, lr = model_lr,
                         max_iter = q6_max_iter)
  result <- evaluate_model(x, y_train, gd$beta)
  q6_losses[[feature]] <- gd$loss
  finite_run <- all(is.finite(gd$beta)) && all(is.finite(gd$loss)) &&
    all(is.finite(result))
  # Loss index 1 is before any updates; the final loss is appended.
  first_positive <- which(is.finite(gd$loss) &
    gd$loss < mean((y_train - mean(y_train))^2))
  first_positive <- if (length(first_positive)) first_positive[1] - 1 else NA_integer_

  lm_uni <- lm(as.formula(paste("Strength ~", feature)),
               data = train_data)

  uni_results <- rbind(uni_results, data.frame(
    Feature = feature,
    Learning_Rate = model_lr,
    Iterations = if (all(is.finite(gd$beta))) length(gd$loss) - 1 else length(gd$loss),
    Status = if (finite_run) "finite" else "non-finite",
    First_Positive_R2_Iteration = first_positive,
    GD_R2 = unname(result["R2"]),
    GD_MSE = unname(result["MSE"]),
    Univariate_Coefficient = unname(coef(lm_uni)[2]),
    Multivariate_Coefficient = unname(coef(lm_raw)[feature])
  ))
}

print(uni_results)
q6_positive_count <- sum(is.finite(uni_results$GD_R2) &
  uni_results$GD_R2 > 0 & uni_results$Status == "finite")
cat("Positive R2 models:", q6_positive_count, "\n")
if (q6_positive_count < 2) {
  cat("Q6 training target not yet met: review learning rate or iteration limit.\n")
}

# Q6.2: use explicit column names so added diagnostics do not change the export.
write.csv(uni_results[, c("Feature", "Univariate_Coefficient",
                          "Multivariate_Coefficient")],
          file.path(output_dir, "Q6_2_Coefficients.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(uni_results, file.path(output_dir, "Q6_Training_Results.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)


# Optimal univariate MSE and R2 alongside existing GD exports.
q6_ols_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(feature_names, function(feature) {
  fit <- lm(reformulate(feature, response = "Strength"), data = train_data)
  scores <- get_scores(fit, train_data)
  data.frame(Feature = feature, Train_MSE = unname(scores["MSE"]),
             Train_R2 = unname(scores["R2"]))
}))
write.csv(q6_ols_results,
          file.path(output_dir, "Q6_Optimal_Univariate_Results.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Training feature correlations for the coefficient discussion.
q6_correlations <- cor(train_data[, 1:8])
write.csv(data.frame(Feature = rownames(q6_correlations), q6_correlations,
                     row.names = NULL, check.names = FALSE),
          file.path(output_dir, "Training_Feature_Correlations.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

```


# 1.7: Statistical Significance
```{r}
# 1. Separate features and target
x <- data[, 1:8]
y <- data[, 9]

# 2. Split data according to professor's instructions
test_idx <- 501:630
train_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(data)), test_idx)

x_train <- x[train_idx, ]
y_train <- y[train_idx]

# 3. Original linear regression
train_raw <- data.frame(
  Strength = y_train,
  x_train,
  check.names = TRUE
)

lm_raw <- lm(Strength ~ ., data = train_raw)

# 4. Standardized linear regression
x_scaled <- as.data.frame(scale(x_train))
names(x_scaled) <- names(x_train)

lm_scaled <- lm(
  Strength ~ .,
  data = data.frame(Strength = y_train, x_scaled)
)

# 5. Log-transformed linear regression
x_log <- as.data.frame(log1p(x_train))
names(x_log) <- names(x_train)

lm_log <- lm(
  Strength ~ .,
  data = data.frame(Strength = y_train, x_log)
)

# 6. Extract p-values
p_table <- data.frame(
  Feature = names(coef(lm_raw)),
  Raw = summary(lm_raw)$coefficients[, 4],
  Standardized = summary(lm_scaled)$coefficients[, 4],
  Log = summary(lm_log)$coefficients[, 4],
  row.names = NULL
)

print(p_table, digits = 6)


# P-values for all three feature configurations.
write.csv(p_table, file.path(output_dir, "Q7_P_Values.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Record the software environment used for this run.
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()),
           file.path(output_dir, "sessionInfo.txt"))

```
